title: Cite des Arts
venue_description:
Cité des Arts

Cité des Arts is a nonprofit performing arts theater and community arts space in downtown Lafayette, offering a black-box theater, rehearsal and gallery space, and a rentable venue for concerts, plays and private events. It has become one of downtown Lafayette's steadiest homes for grassroots, all-ages music.

Atmosphere and Setting

The space has an intimate, community-arts-center feel, with a flexible black-box layout that adapts easily to acoustic music nights, theater productions and gallery openings alike.

Monday Bluegrass Jam

Every Monday evening from 6:30 to 10:00 PM, Cité des Arts hosts a free, all-ages, all-experience-levels Bluegrass Jam, giving pickers and dabblers a welcoming place to meet, learn tunes and play together downtown.

Other Programming

Beyond the weekly jam, Cité des Arts hosts theatrical productions, touring and local concerts, art exhibitions and space rentals for community events throughout the year.

For Performers

The bluegrass jam is a casual, drop-in circle with no sign-up required — musicians of any age or skill level are invited to bring an instrument and join in.

Good to Know

Cité des Arts is located at 109 Vine St, Lafayette, LA 70501, in the heart of downtown.

title: Blue Moon Saloon & Guest House
venue_description:
Blue Moon Saloon & Guest House

Blue Moon Saloon is a world-famous Lafayette institution combining a backyard-stage music venue with an attached guesthouse in a converted downtown home. For more than two decades it has been one of the top destinations in Acadiana for Cajun, zydeco, swamp pop and roots music, drawing both locals and travelers who plan trips around its calendar.

Atmosphere and Setting

Shows happen on a covered outdoor stage in the saloon's backyard, with a laid-back, dance-friendly crowd and a screened-porch bar. The attached guesthouse lets out-of-town visitors stay steps from the music.

Cajun Jam

On Wednesday nights at 8:00 PM, Blue Moon hosts a long-standing weekly Cajun Jam, one of the most well-established drop-in jam sessions in the Lafayette area, drawing traditional Cajun musicians and dancers alike.

Other Programming

Blue Moon's regular calendar includes touring Cajun, zydeco, and Americana acts, making it a cornerstone of downtown Lafayette's live music scene well beyond its weekly jam.

For Performers

The Cajun Jam is an informal, sit-in session rather than a sign-up performance format, open to musicians familiar with the Cajun repertoire as well as those looking to learn.

Good to Know

Blue Moon Saloon & Guest House is located at 215 E Convent St, Lafayette, LA 70501, in downtown Lafayette.

title: Vermilionville
venue_description:
Vermilionville

Vermilionville is a living history museum and folklife park along the Bayou Vermilion in Lafayette, recreating an early Cajun, Creole and Native American settlement through restored and reconstructed historic buildings, costumed interpreters and traditional craft demonstrations. Music has always been central to its mission of keeping Acadiana's culture alive.

Atmosphere and Setting

The park's Performance Center hosts music sessions in a rustic, folklife-museum setting surrounded by the village's historic structures, offering a genuinely immersive backdrop for traditional Louisiana music.

Weekly Cajun Jam

Every Saturday afternoon from 1:00 to 3:00 PM, the Cajun French Music Association sponsors a free jam session at Vermilionville's Performance Center, led by some of the area's finest traditional musicians and open to players of all abilities.

Other Programming

Vermilionville's broader calendar includes cooking demonstrations at La Cuisine de Maman, seasonal festivals, and daily historic interpretation throughout the park.

For Performers

The jam is a come-as-you-are session welcoming fiddle, accordion, guitar and other traditional Cajun instrumentalists at any experience level; admission to the jam itself is free even though the park otherwise charges general admission.

Good to Know

Vermilionville is located at 300 Fisher Rd, Lafayette, LA 70508.

title: Moncus Park
venue_description:
Moncus Park

Moncus Park is a large, modern public park in the heart of Lafayette featuring walking trails, a splash pad, playgrounds and a busy calendar of free community events. Each Saturday morning, it also becomes home to the Lafayette Farmers & Artisans Market, a producers-only market for local growers, bakers and artisans.

Atmosphere and Setting

The market and jam take place outdoors under the park's historic oak trees, with a French-language gathering tent nearby and plenty of family-friendly amenities to enjoy alongside the music.

Cajun Music Jam

From 9:00 to 11:00 AM every Saturday, professional accordionist Chad Huval leads a Cajun music jam session during the farmers market, bringing together fiddles, acoustic guitars, tub bass and washboard for an informal, up-close look at traditional Cajun music in action.

Other Programming

Moncus Park hosts a full seasonal calendar of free community events, including summer concert series and outdoor movie nights, alongside its weekly farmers market.

For Performers

Musicians of varying skill levels are welcome to bring an instrument and sit in with the group; bringing a chair is recommended for anyone planning to stay and play.

Good to Know

Moncus Park is located at 2913 Johnston St, Lafayette, LA 70503. Parking is $2 per hour after the first free 30 minutes.
